MOUZ is questionable due to them going back to play the major without JL and with brollan.
MongolZ can make a run.
Legacy looks strong right now and can be a dark horse.
Other teams are not serious contenders for the major.

My comment was that any top ranked team (Vitality, NaVi, Furia etc.) can make the same excuse of "We win - we win. We lose - saving strats for the major".

Side note / prediction : Falcons will not win this tournament.
